verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official hosted MCP server that agents can connect to by approving OAuth access in the browser. Once connected, it exposes project management, error investigation (search, occurrences, stack traces, affected users), BadgerQL Insights queries, and dashboard CRUD to the AI assistant. A probe also confirms the official MCP docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and use the server successfully.
